args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club (Tuesdays at 7 PM)
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I’d like to invite you to our book club — we meet Tuesday evenings at 7:00 PM at the local library. We’re currently reading mystery novels, and we’d love for you to join us.

If you can make it, please let me know. Feel free to bring any mystery recommendations or just come to listen and join the discussion.

Hope to see you there!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Saturday Farmers Market
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to invite you to the Saturday morning farmers market at the town square. It runs from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM and has great fresh produce — thought you might enjoy it. Hope you can make it!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class — Wednesday Evening
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I’d like to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week on Wednesday evening. We’ll be cooking classic Italian dishes in a small group — it should be a lot of fun.

When: Wednesday evening next week (exact start time to be confirmed)
Where: Culinary Arts Center

Please let me know if you can make it.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Jazz Concert at the Blue Note — Friday 8 PM
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I’d like to invite you to a jazz concert at the Blue Note this Friday at 8:00 PM. It features a local quartet and tickets are $25. Would you like to join?

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6 AM, so going early gives you the best selection.

If you’d like, I can send directions or check their menu/hours for you.

Best,
